prompt: Implement `TokenBucket(rate, capacity, clock)` in solution.py. The bucket starts full and refills at `rate` tokens per second according to the injected clock, never exceeding `capacity`. allow(count) removes count tokens and returns True when enough are available, otherwise leaves the bucket untouched and returns False. tokens() reports the current level. Raise ValueError for a non-positive rate or capacity, or a count below one.
acceptance: refill is proportional to elapsed time and capped at capacity
